posts.cooked:
This is from the ks update about gameplay. 

 

  • 2 for OblivAeon (more on that in the “Gameplay” section) 
  • 10 different Scions (originally, it was five, but then we brought more in)*

Decks:

  • 25 card OblivAeon Deck
  • 25 card Aeon Men Deck
  • 25 card Scion Deck
  • 25 card Mission Deck (this was originally 10 cards, but we added 15 more because we had additional awesome ideas)*

Other:

  • 5 different OblivAeon Shield cards (was originally just one - decided to expand it for more variety)*
  • hero tokens to indicate hero location
  • tokens to indicate Battle Zones

 

Plus 2 environments and five hero decks. 

And then there's the two hero mini expansions and the four void guard decks.

posts.name: Ironic
posts.cooked:
Total Hero decks: 37 decks at 40 cards each.  1,480 cards.

Total Hero character cards: 35 normal heroes, 60 normal variants, 9 cards/variants for the Sentinels, 6 cards/variants for Sky-Scraper.  110 cards.

Total Solo Villain decks: 24 decks at 25 cards each, plus 11 cards for Kaargra's Bloodsworn Colosseum.  611 cards.

Total Solo Villain character cards: 24 decks at 2 cards each, 8 extra Ennead members, 2 cards for the Operative, .  58 cards.

Total Team Villain decks: 15 decks at 20 cards each.  300 cards.

Total OblivAeon decks: 4 decks at 25 cards each, 5 shields.  105 cards.

Total Environment decks: 24 decks at 15 cards each.  360 cards.

Total standard-size cards: 3,124 cards.

(Depending on how many character cards you end up having duplicates of as a result of getting the foil heroes pack, non-foil variant pack, and collecting the original limited-run variants, you may need a few more sleeves, assuming you sleeve every duplicate.  Our hypothetical obsessive collector probably also needs a few extra sleeves for original art Impale and assorted pre-errata things from the first edition - I leave it up to each reader to determine how much of that might apply to themself.)

 

If you're sleeving oversized cards, it's 24 solo villains, 6 villain variants, 2 OblivAeon cards, 10 Scions.  42 Oversized cards.

For Kaarga Warfang you've added 11 extra cards, but there are only two extra cards: Crowd's Favor and the Bloodsworn Colliseum text card. The rest of the Bloodsworn Colliseum cards replace what would have been regular villain cards.

Your numbers add up to 3,024, not 3,124. With the Kaarga Warfang collection, they'll add to 3,015.

 

For myself, I've been collecting the variants along the way, including the eight variant villain cards (four pairs of two each for Blade, Omnitron, Spite, and GloomWeaver), and since I plan to sleeve the Complete Hero Variant Collection (67) and the Foil Hero Correction (110), my total is 3,200.

 

  • EE: 578 (41x10 + 27x4 + 15x4 = 410 + 108 + 60)
  • RC: 222 (41x2 + 27x4 + 2/Operative + 15x2 = 82 + 108 +2 + 30)
  • IR: 228 (41x2 + 27x4 + 8/Ennead + 15x2 = 82 + 108 +8 + 30)
  • ST: 220 (41x2 + 27x4 + 15x2 = 82 + 108 + 30)

  • Mini-expansions: 537 (41x9 + 27x4 + 15x4 = 369 + 108 + 60)
  • Variant Heroes: 68 (YL-1, RCW-1, Ra-1, Fanatic-1, DV-1, EH-1, F6-6, DWatch-4, GIL/B-2, SST-1, Prime Wardens-5, Knyfe-1, Kvothe-1, TNat-3, Santa Guise-1, SI-1, HN-1, CR-1, Se-5, Completionist-1, OU-1, Fugue-1, SSEx-3, CCI-1, VisUn-1, Lum-1, DWHarpy-1, Sgoodguy-1, S&D-1, A'T-1, Como-1, Lifeline-1, XtremePW-5, VGvariants-4, F5-5, Sunset-1)

NOTE: You could also add one more for Cleverest Legacy.
